title: Extending Dilated E0-Semigroups Beyond GNS Representations
exact_target: Find minimality assumptions ensuring that a general Markov dilation descends through its GNS representation and extends to all adjointable module operators.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001184 (OWR-3392-012). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mini-Workshop: Product Systems and Independence in Quantum Dynamics (2009), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2009/09, pp. 493--548; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 50--51, printed pages 542--543.

status_qualification: Both kernel invariance and the full-algebra extension are needed. The phrase not too big is conjectural; generation by i(B) and its time shifts is the report's proposed example of minimality, not a proved sufficient condition.
